objective:
Add the TAGGED capture orchestrator to core-domain: the new brain that, for one stored raw capture, extracts subject/action/time/duration words, decides what to do with them using the already-built deterministic tag logic, and persists exactly one outcome. It is the tag-pipeline twin of the v3 CaptureInterpretationOrchestrator (core-domain services/CaptureInterpretationOrchestrator.kt -- read it, mirror its structure, error handling and KDoc style; do NOT modify it). The v3 classes stay untouched and compiling.

BACKGROUND (all already built and tested, read the KDoc): ActivityExtractor / ExtractionInput / ExtractionResult / ExtractionCandidate (core-domain extraction/ExtractionTypes.kt, untrusted model words, no confidence); ExtractionGrounding.ground(candidate, rawText) -> GroundedExtraction(candidate, timeDropped, durationDropped); TagDecisionPolicy.decide(candidate, catalog) -> TagDecision(outcome AUTO_SAVE|CONFIRM|NEEDS_REVIEW, subject: TagResolution, action: TagResolution, subjectInferred, reasons, resplit) where TagResolution = Empty | Exact(tag: KnownTag, via) | Near(newName, candidates) | New(name) (tagging/TagResolver.kt); TemporalResolver.resolve(expr, capturedAt, zone) -> TemporalResolution Resolved(occurredAt, precision) | Future | Unresolvable (temporal/); DurationResolver.resolve(text): Int? whole MINUTES (temporal/DurationResolver.kt; null = none/unreadable); LedgerRepository = ActivityRepository + TagRepository (repository/TagRepository.kt): loadTagCatalog(), acceptTagged(TaggedAcceptRequest) (TagTarget Existing(tagId) | New(displayName)), recordOutcome(captureId, InterpretationRecord?, ProcessingState) from ActivityRepository. InterpretationRecord already has the tag-path fields extractedSubject / extractedAction / durationExpression / resolvedDurationSeconds (interpretation/InterpretationTypes.kt).

NEW API (new file(s) under core-domain services/ -- names are your call, keep the existing naming style):
`class TaggedCaptureOrchestrator(repository: LedgerRepository, extractor: ActivityExtractor, clock: Clock, resolver: TemporalResolver = TemporalResolver())` with `suspend fun process(captureId: String): TaggedProcessingOutcome`.
`sealed interface TaggedProcessingOutcome`:
- AutoSaved(occurrenceId)
- NeedsConfirm(proposal: TaggedProposal)  -- CONFIRM decision; capture is NEEDS_REVIEW, nothing logged
- NeedsReview(reasons, proposal: TaggedProposal?)  -- NEEDS_REVIEW decision (or an AUTO_SAVE downgraded, see below); nothing logged
- Rejected(reasons)  -- malformed/failed model answer, stored INVALID, capture awaits review
- InterpreterUnavailable(kind: InterpreterFailureKind)  -- capture FAILED_RETRYABLE, no interpretation stored
- AlreadyHasOccurrence
`data class TaggedProposal(captureId, extractedSubject: String?, extractedAction: String?, subject: TagResolution, action: TagResolution, subjectInferred: Boolean, reasons: Set<TagDecisionReason>, occurredAt: Instant?, timePrecision: TimePrecision?, durationExpression: String?, durationSeconds: Long?, activityState: ActivityState?)` -- everything a screen needs to show a 'did you mean ...?' card and later save without asking the model again. It holds the user's own extracted words and is therefore never logged.

PROCESS (mirror v3 step order):
1. capture = repository.getCapture(id) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException (payload-free message, as v3). hasOccurrence -> AlreadyHasOccurrence (extractor not called).
2. catalog = repository.loadTagCatalog(); result = extractor.extract(ExtractionInput(rawText, capturedAt, zoneId)); provenance = extractor.provenance.
3. Failure: UNAVAILABLE / RETRYABLE -> repository.recordOutcome(captureId, null, FAILED_RETRYABLE) and InterpreterUnavailable. MALFORMED -> INVALID InterpretationRecord (operation UNSUPPORTED, activityResolution UNRESOLVED, no tag fields, validationReason from ValidationReason.INTERPRETER_OUTPUT_MALFORMED; OTHER -> INTERPRETER_FAILED), recordOutcome NEEDS_REVIEW, Rejected(setOf(reason)) -- exactly like v3.
4. Success: grounded = ExtractionGrounding.ground(candidate, rawText); decision = TagDecisionPolicy.decide(grounded.candidate, catalog); temporal = resolver.resolve(grounded.candidate.temporalExpression, capturedAt, zoneId); durationSeconds = DurationResolver.resolve(grounded.candidate.durationExpression)?.times(60L).
5. Time and state are checked HERE, not by the policy, and only matter for a silent save: read InterpretationValidator (validation/InterpretationValidator.kt) and the ADR-028 amendment in docs/DECISIONS.md and apply the SAME treatment of TemporalResolution (Future -> TIME_IN_FUTURE, Unresolvable -> TIME_UNRESOLVABLE as the validator and amendment define them -- a time with no words means 'now', INFERRED_NOW, exactly as v3 does) and a missing activityState (STATE_MISSING). An AUTO_SAVE decision with ANY such problem is DOWNGRADED to NeedsReview (never a silent save, never to confirm), with those ValidationReason codes in `reasons`. A CONFIRM or NEEDS_REVIEW decision stays what it is; its proposal still carries whatever time/duration resolved.
6. Persist: build ONE InterpretationRecord with provenance versions, operation (candidate.operation), the grounded words in extractedSubject / extractedAction, grounded temporalExpression + resolvedOccurredAt + timePrecision, activityState, durationExpression + resolvedDurationSeconds, modelConfidenceBand = null, candidateContextHash = null, structuredResultJson = the model's raw JSON if the success result carries one (check ExtractionResult.Success -- it currently does NOT carry raw JSON; do not change extraction types, store null), activityResolution / matchedActivityId / proposedCanonicalName = UNRESOLVED / null / null (the pair is not an activity-level resolution; tags are resolved in acceptTagged), validationStatus VALID for AUTO_SAVE and NEEDS_REVIEW for CONFIRM/NEEDS_REVIEW (use the ValidationStatus constants v3 uses for a review), validationReason = sorted reason codes joined as v3 does. AUTO_SAVE -> repository.acceptTagged(TaggedAcceptRequest(captureId, record, subject target, action target, occurredAt, precision, state, durationSeconds)): an Exact side -> TagTarget.Existing(tag.id); a New side -> TagTarget.New(name); a resolution of Empty/Near cannot occur on AUTO_SAVE (error() with ids only if it does). No alias learning on an automatic save. CONFIRM / NEEDS_REVIEW -> repository.recordOutcome(captureId, record, NEEDS_REVIEW). IllegalArgumentException from the repository propagates (as v3).
7. Model output is never trusted directly: only AUTO_SAVE with a clean time/state creates an occurrence. Model confidence is not consulted. No logging anywhere; exception messages carry ids and enum names only, never words.

TESTS (new files; JVM, no Android): in core-domain test sources (or core-testing if core-domain tests cannot see what they need -- check how existing core-domain service tests are organised and follow that) with a small recording FAKE LedgerRepository and a fake ActivityExtractor: auto-save with existing tags; auto-save creating both new tags from an empty catalog; confirm on a near match (nothing logged, interpretation stored, capture NEEDS_REVIEW, proposal carries the near candidate and resolved time/duration); needs-review (action missing); AUTO_SAVE downgraded to review for future time, unresolvable time, missing state; time/duration invented by the model and dropped by grounding; duration 'for half an hour' -> 1800 s stored on the occurrence request and on the interpretation; failure kinds (unavailable/retryable -> FAILED_RETRYABLE without interpretation; malformed/other -> INVALID + Rejected); AlreadyHasOccurrence does not call the extractor; unknown capture throws. PLUS one end-to-end test in core-data (Robolectric, existing test database helpers in core-data/src/test) running the orchestrator against the REAL Room LedgerRepository with a fake extractor: 'I just changed the hot tub filter' from an empty catalog saves occurrence with two new tags and a pair; the same sentence again as a second capture reuses the tags and pair; a near-match capture leaves capture NEEDS_REVIEW and writes no occurrence.

DOCS: ADR-043 in docs/DECISIONS.md ('Tagged capture orchestrator', Accepted, developer decision 2026-10-04, TG3.1): the step order, that AUTO_SAVE with time/state problems downgrades to review, that the proposal carries the user's words so cards need no second model call, that v3 orchestrator stays until the app switches (TG3.3) and is deleted in a later clean-up. Update the 'last' ADR numbering consistently with the file's existing style. No other doc changes.

RULES: no change to existing v3 services, tagging/, extraction/, temporal/, repository interfaces, core-data main code, schema, core-ai, app-phone or app-wear; no product policy beyond the rules above; no logging; exception messages ids/enum names only.
non_goals: No UI, no app-phone or app-wear change, no wiring (TG3.3).
No resolution/correction service for user answers (TG3.2).
No change to the tag decision policy, resolver, grounding or repositories; if one is needed report scope_change_requested.
acceptance_criteria: TaggedCaptureOrchestrator.process exists in core-domain services with the outcome types above, KDoc'd, mirroring the v3 orchestrator's structure; v3 orchestrator/services and every forbidden path are unchanged.

AUTO_SAVE with clean time and state creates exactly one occurrence through acceptTagged (Exact -> Existing id, New -> New name, duration in seconds), CONFIRM and NEEDS_REVIEW store one interpretation row with the extracted words and set the capture NEEDS_REVIEW without any occurrence, and an AUTO_SAVE with a future/unresolvable time or missing state is downgraded to NeedsReview, never saved.

Extractor failures map exactly as v3 (unavailable/retryable -> FAILED_RETRYABLE with no interpretation; malformed/other -> INVALID row + Rejected); a capture that already has an occurrence never calls the extractor; an unknown capture throws IllegalArgumentException.
Grounding is applied before the policy and the time/duration resolution: invented time or duration words never reach the occurrence.
The listed fake-repository tests and the Robolectric end-to-end test against the real Room ledger pass, including the empty-catalog first entry and the repeat entry reusing tags and pair.
No logging, no model-confidence use, exception messages carry no user words; ADR-043 written; all core-domain, core-data, core-testing and app-phone tests pass.
